mapFolders.name: atlas
mapFolders.reason: The map atlas: one tile pyramid of Blizzard Entertainment's painted world-map art composited with terrain-derived masks, tint and shading, built by tools/maps/atlas.ts and committed and deployed by owner decisions D-033 and D-042, with its NOTICE.md (which lists the D-042 O11 alterations), manifest.json and runtime index.json (docs/research/map-atlas.md §7).
mapFolders.$comment: D-042 O5 (docs/research/map-atlas.md §7.6): at most 8.0 MB gzip-6 for the whole folder, at most 32 kB per tile, and each level's tiles within their baseline + 10%; index.json, manifest.json and NOTICE.md within their own baselines + 10%. Baselines: gzip-6 as atlas.ts wrote the folder in step ATL.6 (792 tiles and 3 files, 6946513 B).

mapFolders.name: minimap
mapFolders.reason: The minimap style: one tile pyramid of Blizzard Entertainment's World of Warcraft client minimap textures with the sea recoloured to one navy, built by tools/maps/minimap.ts and deployed by owner decisions D-033, D-045 and D-049, with its NOTICE.md (which lists the alterations), manifest.json, runtime index.json and the pack pointer pack.json (docs/research/map-atlas.md Part II §18, §23). The tiles are not committed: they come from the release-asset tile pack pack.json names (D-049 O14).
mapFolders.$comment: D-049 (docs/research/map-atlas.md §24.1, §24.3): at most 60 MB gzip-6 for the whole folder, at most 32 kB per tile, and each level's tiles within their baseline + 10% (the signed-off build b5, WebP q80, MEASURED). index.json, manifest.json, NOTICE.md and pack.json within their own baselines + 10%: gzip-6 as minimap.ts wrote them in step MM.4 (6647 tiles, 52170419 B with the four files). The tiles under t/ are external: a build without the pack passes with a note (pnpm build, so pnpm check); a partial set fails; audit-dist.ts --deploy requires every tile.
